Yes. Registration is free and open to anyone, with no qualifiers and no application. The only optional cost is the $29 tournament reset, which lets you wipe one bad match in the first half of a season.

Do I trade with my own money?

No. Every match is played on a fresh $50,000 simulated account. You keep none of the trading losses and you lose nothing beyond your position on the board. Prize money is real.

How do I actually win money?

The top 500 traders in each season get paid. The top four from each season go to the live final in Fort Lauderdale to compete for a separate $400,000 pool. Points come from beating your opponent in each match and from the profit you make, so a lost matchup still scores.

What happens if I get cut?

The bottom half of the board is cut after Match 4. If you don't survive, your season ends there, but Season 2 opens Oct 19 with a completely fresh field and a clean board. Everyone starts on zero, including Season 1 finalists.

Can I enter both seasons?

Yes. The two seasons run back to back and you can play both. Each has its own board, its own $300,000 pool, and its own four seats at the final.

What can I trade?

ES, NQ, GC, and CL futures, with a limit of one contract or ten micros per position. There are no drawdown limits and no disqualifications, so a bad match costs you points, not your place in the league.

FAQs
Is it really free to enter?

Yes. Registration is free and open to anyone, with no qualifiers and no application. The only optional cost is the $29 tournament reset, which lets you wipe one bad match in the first half of a season.

Do I trade with my own money?

No. Every match is played on a fresh $50,000 simulated account. You keep none of the trading losses and you lose nothing beyond your position on the board. Prize money is real.

How do I actually win money?

The top 500 traders in each season get paid. The top four from each season go to the live final in Fort Lauderdale to compete for a separate $400,000 pool. Points come from beating your opponent in each match and from the profit you make, so a lost matchup still scores.

What happens if I get cut?

The bottom half of the board is cut after Match 4. If you don't survive, your season ends there, but Season 2 opens Oct 19 with a completely fresh field and a clean board. Everyone starts on zero, including Season 1 finalists.

Can I enter both seasons?

Yes. The two seasons run back to back and you can play both. Each has its own board, its own $300,000 pool, and its own four seats at the final.

What can I trade?

ES, NQ, GC, and CL futures, with a limit of one contract or ten micros per position. There are no drawdown limits and no disqualifications, so a bad match costs you points, not your place in the league.
